subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

Richard himself came up to __persuade__ David to agree to their plan.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4 i.e. (**Deter**)'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The underlined word "**persuade**" means to induce someone to do something through reasoning or argument.(**मनाना**)
 
• The word "**Deter**" means to discourage (someone) from doing something, typically by instilling doubt or fear of the consequences, which is an antonym to persuade.(**हतोत्साह करना).**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Deter**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Prompt**" (**प्रेरित करना)** means to encourage or persuade (someone) to say or do something.
 
• "**Lure**" (**लुभाना**) means to tempt (a person or an animal) to do something or to go somewhere, especially by offering some form of reward.
 
• "**Coax**" (**मनाना**) means to persuade (someone) gradually or by flattery to do something.
